title: Diagnosis of ON With or Without MS or NMOSD
brief_summary: This is both a prospective and retrospective study of patients with a known diagnosis of optic neuritis (ON) only, multiple sclerosis (MS) with ON, or neuromyelitis spectrum disorder (NMOSD) with ON. There will be no requirement for blinding (patient or assessor) and data collected with the Reflex app will be compared against other data that track optic nerve functional status, such as optical coherence tomography (OCT), visual fields (VF), low-contrast sensitivity, MRI orbits/brain and visual evoked potentials (VEP). Patients who have any diagnosis of ON, with or without a diagnosis of MS or NMOSD and who have had testing using other modalities such as VEPs, VF, low-contrast sensitivity studies, OCT, and MRI of brain or orbits will be included as retrospective subjects in the study. In this cohort, RAPD assessments will be completed and compared to against the data that has accrued as noted.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Male or female patients ages 18-90 years
2. Signed informed consent
3. Have been diagnosed with optic neuritis (ON) only, MS and ON, or NMOSD and ON
4. Have had at least one previous test to track optical nerve function

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Are pregnant or nursing
2. Are children (age \<18 years)
3. Do not have a diagnosis of optic neuritis (ON)
4. Have a diagnosis of MS or NMOSD without a diagnosis of ON as well
study_population: Eligible patients include those seen at the University of Kentucky during routine clinical neurology visits between the ages of 18 and 90 years who have been diagnosed with optic neuritis, optic neuritis and multiple sclerosis, or optic neuritis and neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder and have had at least one previous test that tracks optic nerve function.
